q: Compare net sales, orders, CAC, MER, Net ROAS, and net profit for the last 7 days versus the previous 7 days. Show absolute and percentage change.
answer:
Short answer — last 7 days (2026-10-06..2026-10-12) vs previous 7 days (2026-09-29..2026-10-05):

- Net sales: ₹551,727 vs ₹600,996 → −₹49,269 (−8.2%) — Measured (commerce).
- Orders: 301 vs 316 → −15 (−4.7%) — Measured (commerce).
- CAC (ad spend ÷ new customers): ₹1,998 vs ₹1,607 → +₹391 (+24.3%) — Derived (ad_spend / new_customers; paid_media & commerce).
- MER (net sales ÷ ad spend): 1.4 vs 1.7 → −0.3 (−19.8%) — Derived (net_sales / ad_spend).
- Net ROAS (contribution margin ÷ ad spend): 0.8 vs 0.9 → −0.1 (−13.2%) — Derived (contribution_margin / ad_spend; order_pnl & paid_media).
- Net profit: ₹−82,963 vs ₹−30,856 → −₹52,107 (−168.8%) — Measured (order_pnl).

Compact evidence (previous → current; numbers copy from queries):
- Net sales: ₹600,996 → ₹551,727 (Measured)
- Orders: 316 → 301 (Measured)
- New customers: 215 → 198 (Measured)
- Ad spend: ₹345,581 → ₹395,584 (Measured)
- Contribution margin: ₹314,725 → ₹312,621 (Measured)
- Net profit: ₹−30,855.92 → ₹−82,963.36 (Measured)

Tags: Measured = direct metric from queries; Derived = arithmetic using measured inputs shown above.

Notes / caveats:
- net_roas and pnl_mer catalogue metrics were flagged as not queryable; I computed Net ROAS and MER from measured contribution_margin / net_sales and paid_media ad_spend (see derived formulae). CAC was computed as ad_spend ÷ new_customers (company-level CAC); product-level CAC exists but is different.  
- Data scope: default brand (Tilting Heads) · orders by order_date. Freshness: latest sync ~2026-10-13 17:16 IST; last 7d windows shown above.
